findings.association: erroneous: manufactured from another criterion on the same target
findings.message: The start-up failure card has no logo and no "Reload the page" button. The design puts the on_light logo (on_dark in the dark theme) at the top of the card, with a Reload button under the message. The build put those two logos in a page footer instead, and the design has no logo in the footer. The asset checks R8.17 and R8.18 pass only because they compare the files' bytes, not where the logos are shown. Fix: move the <picture> into the #startup-error card and add the Reload button. Nothing was rendered: this rests on the served HTML, CSS and scripts read over HTTP. observed_on says "browser" only because the review schema has no value for a read that is not rendered. [design review drv_01M571DG72BPRQ6SQN8S4QKQKN, web momentum-lab (startup-error)]

findings.association: erroneous: manufactured from another criterion on the same target

findings.association: erroneous: manufactured from another criterion on the same target
findings.message: The "Why" sentence can say something false when cart 2 is already moving (R6.1). With m₁ > m₂ it always says cart 1 "keeps going", but with m₁ = 2, m₂ = 1, v₁ = 1, v₂ = −10 cart 1 bounces back at −6.33 m/s. With m₁ < m₂ it always says cart 1 "bounces back", but with m₁ = 1, m₂ = 2, v₁ = 10, v₂ = 9 it keeps going at 8.67 m/s. The sentence should follow the sign of v₁′. The owner would fix this first. Nothing was rendered: this rests on the served HTML, CSS and scripts read over HTTP. observed_on says "browser" only because the review schema has no value for a read that is not rendered.
